record.original_question: Characterize the well-filtered dcpos, meaning the directed complete partial orders that admit some well-filtered topology compatible with their original order.

evidence.quote: Definition 4.1. A poset P is said to be well-filtered if there exists a well-filtered topology tau on P which is compatible with the original order of P.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Recall the following definitions. Let $(P,\le)$ be a poset. A topology $\tau$ on $P$ is said to be compatible with the order $\le$ if the specialization order of $\tau$ — namely $x \le_\tau y$ iff $x \in \overline{\{y\}}^\tau$ — coincides with $\le$. A topological space $(X,\tau)$ is called well-filtered if for every filtered family $\{K_i : i \in I\}$ of compact saturated subsets of $X$ (saturated meaning equal to the intersection of its open neighborhoods) and every open set $U \subseteq X$ with $\bigcap_{i\in I} K_i \subseteq U$, there exists some $i_0 \in I$ with $K_{i_0} \subseteq U$.

Call a poset $P$ a well-filtered poset if there exists a well-filtered topology $\tau$ on $P$ that is compatible with the original order of $P$.

Problem: Give an order-theoretic characterization of those directed complete partial orders (dcpos) $P$ that are well-filtered in the above sense; that is, find intrinsic necessary and sufficient conditions on the order structure of a dcpo $P$ which are equivalent to the existence of a well-filtered topology on $P$ whose specialization order is exactly the given order of $P$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of characterizing well-filtered dcpos is an active research topic in non-Hausdorff topology and domain theory. Recent work (e.g., on open well-filtered spaces, strong well-filteredness of the upper topology, and further studies through 2022–2025) continues to investigate sufficient conditions and related variants, but no complete intrinsic order-theoretic characterization of well-filtered dcpos appears to have been established. The question is generally treated as still open.

status_evidence.title: On open well-filtered spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces open well-filtered spaces as an intermediate notion and studies relationships with well-filteredness and sobriety, indicating ongoing work on characterizations.
status_evidence.claim: Characterizations of well-filtered structures remain an active area, with intermediate notions still being introduced.

status_evidence.title: Further studies on open well-filtered spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Continues investigation of well-filtered-type properties on dcpos and topological spaces.
status_evidence.claim: The characterization problem motivates continuing recent research.

status_evidence.title: Strong well-filteredness of upper topology on sup-complete posets
status_evidence.snippet: Studies well-filteredness of specific topologies on classes of posets, indicating that the general characterization is not yet settled.
status_evidence.claim: Specialized sufficient conditions are still being developed, suggesting the general characterization remains open.
